body.name: rectangle-preservation certificates
body.construction: Define \(\mathcal F_x^{\mathrm{val}}(p_x)=\{q\in\Delta_K:h_{\mathcal M_x^{\Box}(p_x)}(e_b-q)\leq v_x(p_x)\ \forall b\}\), and define \(\mathcal F_x^{\mathrm{arg}}(p_x)\) to be the condition \(Q_x^*(p_x)\subseteq\mathcal F_x^{\mathrm{val}}(p_x)\).
